title: Deadline-Bounded Fourfold/Tensor Gardener Campaign
primary_claim: The existing per-user Windows scheduler may invoke one compact Europe/Berlin date-and-queue guard, which in turn invokes the existing bounded daedalus.loop only for an unattempted revision-bound curated task before 2026-09-29. A separate Berlin-midnight trigger performs no candidate execution, stops the canonical kill switch, and retains a final repository topology report.

queue_contract.cross_activation_convergence: one retained Spine attempt per exact current task definition
queue_contract.after_convergence: wait for owner integration or revision-bound queue update

gardener_invariants: prefer deletion, consolidation, movement, or wiring before new abstraction
tensor representation remains an internal typed view and never a fifth semantic plane
one responsibility moves at a time toward kernel, runtimes, orchestration, twin, or evolution
compatibility adapters are thin and carry an explicit removal condition
dependent packets remain blocked until their predecessors are owner-integrated and the queue base is rebound
no branch is merged, force-updated, or deleted without containment and owner review
benchmark losses, ablations, costs, failures, and uncertainty remain inspectable
CrewAI or AlphaEvolve superiority is never inferred from architecture or an incomparable proxy
acceptance: campaign JSON rejects authority escalation, unbounded values, non-Berlin timezone, and inconsistent cutoff dates
pre-cutoff activation invokes exactly one existing daedalus.loop process with every configured bound
the effective iteration count cannot exceed the remaining unattempted task-definition count
a current task definition with a retained Spine attempt is not dispatched by later campaign polls
when all current ready definitions are attempted, the guard retains a waiting-owner receipt and executes no candidate
cutoff activation reaches finalization without reading the work queue or invoking the loop
scheduled-task installation uses IgnoreNew, Interactive logon and Limited run level and includes a distinct final trigger
the Windows trigger represents 2026-09-29 00:00 Europe/Berlin even on a host in another timezone
campaign installation runs guard status before arming or registering the task
a sticky operator stop cannot be silently overridden; scheduled commands never contain --force
activation and final receipts retain exact Masterplan digest/revision, repository HEAD, branch refs and worktrees
work queue is the only enabled picker source and is bound to one exact candidate base revision
policy blocks all code writes outside daedalus/twin and daedalus/evolution
scheduler and guard sources contain no merge, push, reset, promotion, OwnerApproval or PromotionReceipt operation

prepared: Python compile checks for guard and focused tests
focused campaign contract, cutoff, convergence and authority tests
canonical scheduler generic and campaign regression tests
verification.hosted_ci: blocked by issue #67; zero-step jobs are not evidence
verification.claim: source and test preparation only; no exact-head green result and no Windows task installed

rollback: run tools/continuous_daedalus.ps1 Uninstall with the same CampaignFile and ScheduledTaskName on the owner machine
retain activation/final receipts and negative evidence
non_goals: automatic implementation of blocked dependent packets before owner integration
a claim that Daedalus already beats CrewAI or AlphaEvolve
changing the adopted Masterplan or amendment chain
